second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (50 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side prints 32 twice (q032, q032b) and the last question as '60.' after 50 (gaps 51-59); 52 questions. Answer side 1-25, [match block], one-mark 27-36 (+1 from q032b: keys 33-36 answer q032b-q035, EMPTY + pointer), two-mark run restarts at '36.' (aligned), 37-50; q060 no key. Difficulty per question: easy 38, average 7, difficult 7, untagged 0.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 83 (heading, LO) 84-86; A pdf 179 (heading, keys 1-22) 180-182.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-15; s3 T/F q16-25; s4 '26. Match the following correctly (easy)' q26 (10 rows; Q-side labels garbled); s5 one mark q27-35 (incl. q032b) vsa; s6 two marks q36-41 sa; s7 three marks q42-46 sa; s8 four marks q47-50, q060 la.

NUMBERING (ruled shapes; analysis reports/class-4-evs/evs-4-20_numbering_analysis.md): repeated label 32 -> q032b; keys 33-36 answer q032b-q035 (+1 band, 4 q, default lane); the two-mark run's own '36.' pairs with q036; '60.' printed for the 51st question -> id q060 + 'numbering label misprint', gaps 51-59.

Keys 47, 48, 50 print a title line ('Independence Day Celebration in My School' …) then a paragraph -> title kept in answer.value, not a step; q49 title + 4 bullets. q36 key 'National festivals… / Examples: …' joined as one paragraph.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_20.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.

We celebrate Independence Day every year on August 15. The headmaster hoists the national flag. We sing the national anthem. Students give speeches and perform dances and songs. The chief guest gives a speech. Sweets are distributed to all.

questions.text: Explain the national emblem of India?
questions.text_as_printed: Explain the national emblem of India? (Average)
questions.section_signal: Answer the following questions (four marks questions)

answer.value:
National Emblem of India
It has four lions standing back to back. It shows courage, strength, and truth. It is taken from the Ashoka Pillar. Below the lions, "Satyameva Jayate" is written, which means “Truth alone triumphs.”

questions.text: Mention the four national symbols and explain their significance.
questions.text_as_printed: Mention the four national symbols and explain their significance.Difficult)
questions.section_signal: Answer the following questions (four marks questions)

answer.value:
Four National Symbols
National Flag: Has three colours and a wheel. It shows unity and peace.
National Bird: Peacock. It is beautiful and represents grace.
National Animal: Tiger. It shows strength and courage.
National Anthem: “Jana Gana Mana.” It shows respect and love for our country.

questions.text: Write an article on how Children's Day is celebrated in your school

questions.section_signal: Answer the following questions (four marks questions)

answer.value:
Children’s Day in Our School
Children’s Day is celebrated on November 14, the birthday of Jawaharlal Nehru. Teachers give speeches about Nehru. Games and drawing competitions are held. Cultural programs are performed by students. Sweets and prizes are given to all children.
